Signed by President Theodore Roosevelt Monday, January 4, 1904

1904 CSR 86

607015Executive Order 243 — Authorizing Reinstatement of Evelyn M. Ford as Clerk in the War Department Without Regard to Civil Service Rules1904President of the United States

Mrs. Evelyn M. Ford may be reinstated to the position of clerk in the office of the Secretary of War without regard to the provisions of Rule IX limiting the period of eligibility to one year from the date of separation.

Theodore Roosevelt.

White House,

January 4, 1904.
